newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Bank of Melbourne cuts variable home loan.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Melbourne cuts variable home loan.

text.p: Regional bank, Bank of Melbourne Ltd (BML) said on Friday it had cut its variable owner occupied home loan rate by a half a percent to 6.7 percent from 7.2 percent after a cut in the official cash rate on Wednesday.
BML said the new rate would be effective immediately for new borrowers and from September 29 for existing borrowers.

The bank said it had also reduced its home loan two year fixed term rate to 6.99 percent from 7.2 percent, three years fixed to 7.25 percent from 7.5 percent and five years fixed to 7.75 percent from 7.95 percent.
On Wednesday Australia's central bank eased monetary policy with a 50 basis point cut in official cash rates to 5.0 percent.
Australia's major banks, National Australia Bank Ltd, Westpac Banking Corp, ANZ Bank and Commonwealth Bank of Australia have all moved to cut their standard variable home loan rates.
